remaining_limitations: Assessment uses the supplied images and source text. Figure 2: Overview of our proposed VEvo-Harness pipeline. A self-evolving scaffold is built around
(a) a Interaction Loop for generation and verification, comprising (b) Visual Traceback, (c) Visual
Continual Governance, (d) Lifecycle-Managed Harness State, and (e) Heterogeneous Action Sandbox.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed the final VEvo-Harness framework and read the caption and source framework/skill-promotion paragraphs. All original a-e panels remain as a protected full scientific diagram, including bookstore examples, frozen generator/judge, root-cause tree, intervention/counterfactual replay, memory and sandbox options. The added b-diagnose, e-intervene, c-verify, d-consolidate order follows the source process, and the persistent-library gate is explicitly supported by the counterfactual-verification passage. The strip is a reading summary, not an invented alternative loop; no outcomes, diagnostic statuses, or example contents change.
